The simulated ledger shows 700 cents left, which could still be drained. The three shops (West Asheville Pet Supply, Cafe and Deli) were each paid in full from escrow, and nothing shows pool-funded payments or silence on their side. They look like victims or bystanders, so no merchant action or notice is needed. West Asheville has no alerts. A second cert, 1a40851a... (home swannanoa), made the identical 1500/1500/1300 sequence at the same three shops about 4 hours earlier. That repeat suggests an organised or scripted pattern rather than one traveller, and that cert needs its own review. The weaker alternative is an honest resident stocking up while away from home. I could not check contacts or device logs because those tools need a device public key, and I only have the cert id. A human should try to reach the owner before or alongside the freeze.

rows.summary: Dismiss: Downtown Outfitters looks like a victim of three double-spending certs, not a colluding shop. The silence signal is weak and not specific to this shop.
rows.reasoning: Why it was flagged: silence_ratio 0.11 (1 contact vs a neighbor median of 1.5/h), pool_funded_share 1.0, and one one-sided contact. Why I don't think it is real: (1) Three certs (1a61b79e…, 746a69d2…, 0c922fa6…) each double-spent counter 1 with the same prev_hash. The first spend went to Downtown Shelter (ec6b5241…, 8067bfe1…, 7a07dc2…) and the second to Outfitters (801a84f4…, b728490e…, 5443d153…). verify_tags shows SAME_COUNTER on each of those pairs, and the certs are already frozen. Each cert's second spend is always the one that draws on the pool, so 100% pool share follows from the order of spending and says nothing about the shop. (2) Downtown Shelter took the same three certs plus a fourth frozen cert (16ff530c…) and nobody suspects it. Outfitters has no special link to the cheaters. (3) Outfitters' log chain is intact. Its three ACCEPT entries (aab547fb…, 9fd9b303…, 154b9322…) are all direct, with empty held_ids, so there is no sign it held a conflicting tag. That means no MERCHANT_KNEW proof and no hidden tags. (4) Its earlier history is about 33 ordinary escrow-funded payments, with no near-cap clustering (near_cap_share 0). (5) The later-window features show neighbors also at 0 contacts/h, so the quiet is regional, and the region status has no alerts and a recent upload. (6) Only 1 cheater cert fell inside the candidate window itself. The pool-funded cost (3 × 2000 = 6000c) is already covered by the SAME_COUNTER hard cases on those certs. Caveat: contact data is thin. Re-flag if more cheater certs show up here while its contacts stay near zero.
